descriptionChirho: To go astray or wander from a path, either literally (physical wandering) or figuratively (moral/spiritual deviation); the core Qal sense of deviating from the right way.
To commit an inadvertent error or sin through ignorance or negligence, emphasizing the unintentional nature of the transgression rather than deliberate straying.
To be captivated, enraptured, or intoxicated, especially in the context of sexual love or wine (Proverbs 5:19-20), where the 'going astray' is a pleasurable losing of oneself.
Causative Hifil stem meaning to cause someone to go astray, mislead, or lead into error; used of those who deceive or misdirect others.
